items.title: Berkshire Hathaway Inc. to Acquire OxyChem
items.snippet: Occidental announced a definitive agreement for Berkshire Hathaway to acquire OxyChem for $9.7 billion; the release says the transaction strengthens Occidental’s financial position and unlocks long-term resource runway.

items.title: oxy-20250630
items.snippet: Occidental’s Form 10-Q for the quarter ended June 30, 2025 includes revenue-related disclosure and notes on OxyChem tariffs and segment earnings.

items.title: oxy-20251231
items.snippet: Occidental’s 2025 Form 10-K discusses 2026 capital expenditures of $5.5 billion to $5.9 billion, liquidity, debt maturities, and risk factors including international political or civil instability, OPEC production restrictions, import restrictions, and sanctions.

items.title: ANNUAL REPORT
items.snippet: Occidental’s annual report discusses valuation, impairment, and risk-related assumptions in its oil and gas portfolio and future net cash flow estimates.
